hook: A DAY LONGER THAN A YEAR
yt_title: On Venus a Day Is Longer Than a Year #Shorts
desc: Venus spins so slowly that one day there lasts about 243 Earth days, while it circles the Sun in about 225. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Imagine a day that never ends. 🪐 Would you live on Venus? Comment below.

lines.text: On Venus, a day is longer than a year.
Venus takes about two hundred forty three Earth days to spin once.
But it circles the Sun in only about two hundred twenty five.
So the day is longer than the year. And it even spins backwards.
Yes, the Sun rises in the west there.
